hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a symmetric U-shaped term in x4: the target is higher than predicted when |x4| is near or above 1 and lower than predicted when |x4| is below about 0.5.
rationale: The four positive residuals have x4 = +1.04, +0.98, -1.41, +1.31, whereas the six negative residuals have x4 in [-0.49, +0.47]. Because large-magnitude x4 of either sign gives positive residuals and small-magnitude x4 gives negative residuals, an even function of x4 is missing.
